sources.snippet: SmolVLA training is governed by YAML configuration files that define dataset locations, policy hyperparameters, and logging settings. The repository provides two primary configurations: smolvla_pih.yaml for peg-in-hole tasks and smolvla_omy.yaml for pick-and-place tasks.
